text:
taylor: Quick postmortem follow-up. Need to finalize customer-facing comms owners and timelines for three items: 1) status page short line, 2) 72-hour redacted technical summary, 3) RCA-sharing policy + CSM guidance. Also: weve seen prefix-KV cache pressure surface in multiple incidents — want that noted as a recurring trend. Proposed owners: @nina for status page, @rahul for 72h brief, @jade + @legal for RCA policy & CSM guidance. Please ack and give ETA.

nina: Ack. Ill own status page. Draft below (short, customer-facing). Open to tone edits.

nina: ```
Update: We experienced partial degradation affecting a subset of inference requests. Service was restored at 22:41 UTC.
Impact: increased latency and intermittent errors for impacted requests between 20:1222:41 UTC.
Cause: prefix KV cache pressure (under investigation).
Note: this incident is part of a recurring cache-pressure trend were tracking.
Next: a 72-hour redacted summary with remediation milestones will be shared.
```

rahul: Ack. Ill draft the 72h redacted summary. Question for legal: should the 72h include any stack snippets or trace excerpts, or keep it high-level?

legal: Legal: do not include raw traces, session tokens, internal hostnames, or PII in public-facing docs. You can list affected components and a high-level timeline. For enterprise customers we can provide deeper artifacts via secure/account channels under contract.

jade: From comms/CSM POV: proposed RCA policy sentence for public docs: "A redacted RCA will be provided to all impacted customers within 72 hours. Enterprise customers may request the full RCA through their account team per contractual terms." Also will draft a short CSM script.

taylor: That policy wording looks good. Confirmed redaction rules from legal. Now timelines: nina -> status page final by tomorrow EOD; rahul -> 72h redacted summary by Fri 17:00 UTC; jade/legal -> RCA policy + CSM script by Fri COB. Please confirm or suggest changes.

nina: I can PR the status page copy by 18:00 UTC tomorrow and will add a one-line pointer to the 72h doc when available.

rahul: ETA Fri 17:00 UTC for 72h draft is fine. Ill flag redacted sections for legal review in the doc.

jade: Will prepare policy wording and a CSM template by Fri COB. Ill include the account contact flow for enterprise artifact requests.

taylor: Also assigning remediation owner actions (please confirm):
- infra: alerting for cache-pressure signals + automated soft-eviction (owner: rahul, ETA 10 business days)
- runtime: KV cache sizing and backpressure audit (owner: rachel, ETA 5 business days)
- product: query-pattern analysis to reduce long prefixes (owner: maya, ETA 3 weeks)
Add these tasks to the incident tracker and link them here.

opsbot: Created INC-5333 "Customer transparency: status line, 72h redacted summary, RCA policy & mitigation tasks" assigned to nina/rahul/jade, due 2026-04-30. Link: https://tracker.internal/INC-5333

csm-bot: Posted draft CSM playbook stub: https://internal.docs/csm/incident-rca-requests  will append Jade's script when available.

taylor: Quick decisions recap: status page final by tomorrow EOD (nina); 72h redacted summary by Fri 17:00 UTC (rahul); public redacted RCA to all impacted customers and full RCA available to enterprise via contract (owners: jade/legal). Remediation owners noted and tasks created.

jade: Ill follow up with a one-page CSM script and example email by Friday.

rahul: Starting the 72h draft now; will ping for tech review and legal redaction check when first pass is ready.

nina: Will include the recurring-pattern callout and a link to the tracker task in the status page PR.

taylor: If anything is blocked, prefix the message with "blocker:" so we can escalate. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
